claims.claim: The workflow helps a product manager turn discovery evidence into a reviewable product decision package.
Configurable templates change reviewed report structure without mutating evidence, requirements or the PRD.
The core workflow, template boundaries, feedback replay and trial are covered by automated tests.
A reviewer can reproduce both the successful discovery package and the blocked unsafe-template path.
External template components were screened with exact version, commit and license evidence before dependency selection.
Accepted synthetic template feedback is reproduced as a deterministic regression while pending feedback stays excluded.
The repository discloses synthetic inputs, no-model execution, human approval and production gaps.
Optional local grounded modes produce cited summaries with a deterministic fallback and never execute a remote model call or external action.
The offline service contract validates schema and grounded mode, emits a deterministic retry receipt and performs no persistence or external action.
Fallback and local-extractive service outputs can be compared for human review without approval, mutation or external action.
Synthetic reviewer decisions are summarized chronologically against a stable request fingerprint without approving a mode or mutating discovery evidence.
